reasons: A correctly grounds the property deduction in ст. 220 НК РФ, while B consistently cites ст. 219 (the social deduction article) and adds further legal errors, such as saying co-owners share one 2 million limit. B also starts with a stray timestamp line. A has its own minor inaccuracies, but its core legal framing is correct.

A: Simplified procedure (ст. 221.1) was introduced by Federal Law 100-ФЗ of 20.04.2021, not 131-ФЗ of 08.04.2021
Simplified procedure eligibility depends on the bank or tax agent participating in information exchange with ФНС, not on buying from a developer or under a notarized contract
Employer route is governed by п. 8 ст. 220, not п. 3 ст. 221
ФНС hotline number 802-122-002 is wrong (it is 8-800-222-22-22)
Describes the progressive НДФЛ scale as only under discussion, although it was adopted and has applied since 2025
B: Cites ст. 219 НК РФ as the basis for the property deduction; it is ст. 220
Cites ст. 219.1 for the employer route; this is wrong (п. 8 ст. 220)
Cites п. 6 ст. 219 for the related-party exclusion; this is wrong (п. 5 ст. 220)
Claims co-owners share one 2 million limit split by share; since 2014 each owner has their own 2 million limit
Ignores the 2025 progressive НДФЛ scale and presents 13/15% as the full current rates
